description: Asks how a stored BIGINT column (ACCDB only; table Bg created by DDL) takes values and what arithmetic over it returns. Inserted through SQL: the largest and smallest signed 64-bit literals, CLngLng(5), the text '9223372036854775807', 2.5, one past the maximum, 1E19, Null, the text 'x', and 2^62 and 2^62 + 1. Then, for the rows with ID 1, 2, 3 and 10 separately, B + 1, B - 1, B * 2, B / 2, B \ 2, B Mod 7, -B, Abs(B), B + 1.5 and B * B, each with the inner VarType, as its own snapshot. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
